snippet.title: Mortal Shell II Beta - Now Live on PS5 and Xbox
snippet.description:
Play the opening three hours of Mortal Shell II in this limited free Beta, available now on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S.

Step into the ravaged world of Mortal Shell II ahead of its worldwide release on August 20. Select progress in the Beta also carries forward into the full game. 

-------------------------------------
BETA LINKS:
PlayStation: https://store.playstation.com/product/EP3495-PPSA38671_00-000000000000BETA

Xbox: https://www.xbox.com/games/store/mortal-shell-ii-open-beta/9N1NPQRFBGTX

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2584270/Mortal_Shell_II


-------------------------------------
PLAY THE FULL GAME 72 HOURS EARLY

Mortal Shell II releases worldwide on Steam, PSS, and Xbox Series X|S on August 20.

Players can begin the game as soon as August 17 by pre-purchasing the Mortal Shell II Devout Edition now and getting up to 72 hours Advanced Access.
